defective_pattern: Relying on naive character length heuristics (e.g., len(text) > 20) to distinguish valid bibliographic references from document subheadings.
why_defective: Subheadings (such as 'الف) منابع و مآخذ فارسی (کتب و مقالات)') often exceed 20 characters and bypass length-only filters, leaking into bibliographies as erroneous references. It fails to enforce structural bibliographic validation.
observed_symptoms: Document subheadings erroneously appearing in compiled reference lists.
Non-citation text blocks classified as references.
corrective_remedy: Enforce structural bibliographic validation. A paragraph must only be classified as a reference if it contains standard citation markers (e.g., a 4-digit year in parentheses) or meets rigorous regex criteria for APA 7 formatting. Filter subheadings explicitly.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect naive length check heuristic in reference extraction logic without year/marker validation.
